programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers.

programs.title: Japan on a plate
programs.desc: Alexa Łuczak moved to the Land of the Rising Sun over ten years ago.During this time, she mastered the language on her own, which allowed her to host one of the local television programs.The model decided to share her knowledge about extraordinary Asian cuisine.Her search for local flavors will take her to small bars hidden in the city's alleys, to the largest fish bazaar in all of Japan and to the establishments of the most talented sushi masters.The host will also visit elegant restaurants in Tokyo.There is no shortage of vending machines and fresh seafood in this city.Viewers will also learn more about Japan itself, its traditions and culture.

programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild 2
programs.desc: Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a journalist.In the program, fate throws them to distant and dangerous corners of the world.

programs.title: Man v Food 2
programs.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern visits various cities around the world.In each of them, he presents dishes typical of a given place.
